question:
The given reaction is an example of _______.

2 Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe
solution:
The correct answer is __**displacement reaction.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Displacement Reaction: 

 
 
• It is also known as the **S**ingle Replacement Reaction.

 
 
• It **involves a more reactive element displacing a less reactive element from its compound.**
 
• The reaction of potassium with magnesium chloride is an example of a single displacement reaction.
 
 
• Reaction: 2K + MgCl2 → 2KCl + Mg
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given reaction, 2 Al atoms **replaces** the 2 Fe atoms in Fe2O3 to form Al2O₃ as **Aluminium (Al) is more reactive than Iron (Fe)**.
 
• This is an example of a **displacement reaction **as one element is displaced by another element in a compound.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Double Displacement Reaction:**

 
 
• It is **also known as Bi-displacement reaction.**
 
• It** involves two reactants exchanging their ions to form two new products.**
 
• For example, potassium nitrate reacts with aluminium chloride and forms aluminium nitrate and potassium chloride. 
 
 
• Reaction: KNO3 + AlCl3 ↔️ Al(NO3)3 + KCl
 
 
 
 
 
• Reduction Reaction:
 
 
• The chemical reaction which involves addition of hydrogen or removal of oxygen is called reduction.
 
• The process of reduction is a type of chemical reaction in which the electron density of an atom or molecule is increased.
 
• Gaining hydrogen would lead to a decrease in the oxidation state of the substance.
 
• Losing oxygen would lead to a decrease in the oxidation state of the substance.
 
 
 
• Oxidation Reaction:
 
 
• The che mical reaction which involves addition of oxygen or removal of hydrogen is called oxidation.
 
• It involve the loss of electrons or increase in the oxidation state of an atom or molecule.
 
• Losing hydrogen would lead to an increase in the oxidation state of the substance.
 
• Gaining ox ygen would lead to an increase in the oxidation state of the substance.
